game.title: Scales & Seeds: Underground Ecosystem Tales
game.subtitle: A Living World Beneath the Surface
game.motto: Every scale tells a story. Every seed holds the promise of new life.

login.welcome_message: Every scale tells a story; every seed holds the promise of life.

species.hognose_desc: A small terrestrial snake with a distinctive upturned snout. Known for its gentle temperament and habit of burrowing into substrate.

default_entries.patternless_discovered: This individual has no elaborate markings, displaying a clean and elegant patternless appearance. Under the underground lighting, its simple beauty creates a calm and reassuring impression.
default_entries.speckled_discovered: Today's observation revealed high-contrast random white spots and distinctive markings across the body! Is this the result of a genetic mutation or adaptation to the microclimate? Further observation is needed.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome back to the underground terrarium! Have you carefully checked the temperature and humidity of the microclimate today?
dialogue.patternless_comment: Oh? This little one has no unnecessary markings. Such a pure and clean patternless appearance! Its simple elegance is truly pleasing to the eye.
dialogue.speckled_comment: Take a look at the changing patterns on its back! Every spot is uniquely distributed. This little one will surely become a highlight of the encyclopedia!

dialogue.greeting: Hey, Ecologist! Your climate-controlled underground package has arrived today!
dialogue.delivery: Don't worry! I carefully checked the temperature and humidity controls throughout transportation. Your package is ready to be opened and placed in the terrarium.

dialogue.greeting: Heh heh... The deep underground tunnels hide many ancient genetic clues and unusual plant seeds.
dialogue.mystery_egg: Would you like to try incubating this mysterious egg found in a deep rock crevice? It might bring a wonderful surprise to your terrarium.

vet.title: Underground Reptile Veterinary Clinic
vet.outpatient_desc: Uses a small amount of Action Points and a basic consultation fee. Suitable for routine health checks and mild early symptoms.
vet.emergency_desc: Prioritizes critical conditions and requires more Action Points and a higher treatment fee.
vet.hospitalization_desc: Provides long-term environmental adaptation and physical recovery under observation. Progress updates according to real-world time.
vet.cause_of_death: Cause of Death Analysis & Environmental Review

ad.boost_desc: Watch an optional rewarded advertisement to gain an additional 6 hours of effective creature growth time. Limited to 2 uses per day.
ad.notice: Note: Advertisement boosts do not affect disease recovery, life-or-death decisions, or the probability of special genetic traits.
